notes:
{席|せき} means a seat, place, or occasion/gathering.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {座席|ざせき}: seat
- {空席|くうせき}: vacant seat
- {満席|まんせき}: full, no seats available
- {指定席|していせき}: reserved seat
- {自由席|じゆうせき}: unreserved seat
- {席順|せきじゅん}: seating order

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {席|せき}を{取|と}る: to get a seat
- {席|せき}を{譲|ゆず}る: to give up one's seat
- {席|せき}を{外|はず}す: to step away (from desk/seat)
- この{席|せき}は{空|あ}いていますか: Is this seat free?

EXTENDED MEANING:
お{酒|さけ}の{席|せき} means a drinking occasion/party, not just a physical seat.
